summary.text: John Williams is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A financial advisor, he has served in the West Virginia House of Delegates since 2016 and currently represents District 80, a seat he is not seeking again in 2026.

paragraphs.text: John Williams was born in Morgantown, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University.
His career experience includes working as a financial advisor.
Williams has been a member of the House of Delegates since 2016, and his current term representing District 80 began on December 1, 2022 and ends on December 1, 2026.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Senate District 13 on May 12, 2026.
